description: Separate the exact native-compatible MargData contract from Rust-only schema4 extensions.

required_fields: visual factor identity and observation rows
native_compatible.acceptance_rule: All required fields must be exact or exact_absent, all declared paths and source identity must be recomputed, and optional fields must carry native_absent evidence.

frame_sidecars.mapping: timestamp key, quaternion_wxyz wire order, and Basalt left-local UpstreamF32 chart

prior_fej_point.requires: event-bound reduced-prior order plus same-run Rust PriorData.fej_point bit oracle

prior FEJ point / anchor.reason: Per-frame native FEJ sidecars have a deterministic adapter; the reduced PriorData.fej_point remains unproven until a same-run prior vector oracle is bound.

kf_to_marg equivalent.reason: Native removeKeyframes removes selected hosts/observations and does not expose a destination/reanchor pair.

rust_extension.acceptance_rule: A full Rust extension profile is accepted only after explicit rust_extension_exact mappings and same-event bit oracles are captured; a candidate or raw native evidence never upgrades one.

numeric_path: Bridge/schema classification only; Rust estimator arithmetic and lifecycle are unchanged.
